Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 653 PM EST Sat Nov 7 2026

- Cloud clearing trend into tonight. 

- Slightly milder and breezy tomorrow.

- Temperatures stay on the warmer side of average through mid week 
  before a cool down arrives late week.

&&

.AVIATION...

Shortwave ridging aloft and a surge in westerlies will bring result 
in dry air advection across Southeast Michigan tonight. While some 
MVFR stratus will hold on the first couple of hours of the period, 
there is overwhelming signal for active and lowering subsidence 
below 8.0 kft agl tonight. Southwest gradient flow will increasing 
substantially ahead of a weak cold front on Sunday. Some uncertainty 
exists on the coverage of boundary layer cloud as model sounding 
show the layer of saturation to be very shallow.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

* Low for ceiling 5000 ft tonight.
